description: Federal Register search for US rules, proposed rules, notices and presidential documents by keyword, agency, type and publication date, or one document by number. Useful for regulatory monitoring and compliance research. Returns title, type, action, abstract, agencies, effective and comment-close dates, docket IDs, RINs, CFR parts, citation and official HTML/PDF links, with source URL and retrievedAt. Errors: 400 invalid input, 404 unknown document. PAID: $0.002 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/federal-register/search.
name: federal_register_search
title: Federal Register document search
